It is based on the [[JN040|animated series episode by the same name]]. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Goh]] is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{TP|Goh|Flygon}}. * [[Goh's Raboot]] learns {{m|Blaze Kick}}. * Goh tries and fails to catch a {{p|Zapdos}}. ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Zapdos}} * {{p|Flygon}} ({{OP|Goh|Flygon}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * [[Goh]] * [[Chloe]] * [[Professor Cerise]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Raboot}} ({{OP|Goh|Raboot}}) * {{p|Flygon}} ({{OP|Goh|Flygon}}) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Professor Cerise]]'s; [[Rotom Phone]]) * {{p|Zapdos}} ==Differences between the animated series and the manga== * As the events of ''[[JN036|Making Battles in the Sand!]]'' were skipped, [[Goh's Flygon]] debuts here. * {{TRT}}'s appearance is omitted. As such, {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] face {{p|Zapdos}} in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] instead of a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]]. * Ash's reason for being unable to continue battling was changed to {{AP|Pikachu}} being injured by Zapdos's {{m|Thunder}}. {{stub|Manga}} {{MangaPrevNext |prevcode=JNM11 |prevtitle=Solitary and Menacing! |nextcode=JNM13 |nexttitle=Sword and Shield...
